slides.headline: Why do they need $40B
slides.body: Pushing frontiers toward AGI requires scaling compute infrastructure, custom silicon, and gigawatt-scale data centers.
sides: Analysis of compute requirements for frontier AI models.
The cost of frontier AI research has priced out almost every standard tech company.
